faqs.q: How do I complete an application?
faqs.a: If the application is available for online submittal you will go to www.arvadapermits.org to complete your online application. Not all applications are available online, please check the table above. Applications can also be made by sending your application and plans to us via emailing Building Permits Division. We encourage you to use these online methods to submit applications. However, if needed, paper applications and plans may be dropped off at City Hall for processing. Permits are no longer processed over the counter. The City of Arvada uses SMART License & Permits for the permit application process, this system requires a login to create applications. If you are a licensed contractor you must use your Contractor License number and password. New to SMART License & Permits? View our log in instructions and SMART License & Permits application guide. Returning User? Login to the SMART License & Permits application.
